title: Shmuel, a Temple official
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Tosefta Shekalim, chapter 2, lists the Temple officials and says Shmuel was in charge of the chavitin, the griddle-cake offerings. Shekalim 5:1 lists Matityah ben Shmuel in charge of the lotteries.[^1]

notes.text: Tosefta Shekalim 2 explicitly lists Shmuel over the chavitin. Mishnah Shekalim 5:1 lists Matityah ben Shmuel over the lotteries. These two notices are retained as separate occurrences; no identification between the named officials is asserted.
